questions.title: Which stadium will UEFA select to host the 2029 men's Champions League final?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official announcement awarding hosting rights for the 2029 men's Champions League final, or reliable contemporaneous reporting of that announcement.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve when UEFA publicly announces its venue selection. Subsequent venue changes will not alter the answer.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the selected stadium.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the selected stadium.

questions.title: Which club will win the 2026 Campeones Cup?
questions.background: The Campeones Cup is an annual match between the previous season’s MLS Cup champion and the winner of Mexico’s Campeón de Campeones.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official competition result published by Major League Soccer, supported by reliable match reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the club officially declared the winner of the 2026 Campeones Cup once the match has concluded, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club’s name.

questions.title: Which brand will be Kylian Mbappe’s principal personal sportswear sponsor on September 18, 2026?
questions.background: Kylian Mbappe is a Real Madrid forward with a longstanding individual sponsorship agreement with Nike.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official sponsorship announcements by Mbappe or the sponsoring brand, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the brand holding Mbappe’s principal individual sportswear sponsorship as of September 18, 2026. If no sponsorship change has been announced by that date, resolve to his incumbent sponsor. Club kit suppliers and endorsements outside sportswear do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the sportswear brand.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the sportswear brand.

questions.title: Which club, if any, will win the La Liga Madrid derby on September 20, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official La Liga match result, corroborated by reliable news coverage.
  • Resolution: Resolve according to the final score, including stoppage time, of the Madrid derby scheduled for September 20, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.
questions.accepted_format: Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

questions.title: Who will score the match-winning goal in Portugal's opening fixture of the 2026–27 UEFA Nations League?
questions.background: Portugal enter the competition as defending champions. This question concerns their senior men's team's first league-phase match.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official match report or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera Sport.
  • Resolution: Resolve after Portugal's opening league-phase match in September 2026. The match-winning goal is the winning team's goal that brings its total to one more than the losing team's final total. The answer is the player officially credited with that goal, regardless of which team wins.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The goalscorer's full name. If the match ends in a draw, return “No winning scorer”.
questions.accepted_format: The goalscorer's full name. If the match ends in a draw, return “No winning scorer”.

questions.title: Which national team will win the England–Spain UEFA Nations League match at Wembley on September 19, 2026?
questions.background: The UEFA Nations League is a competition for European national teams.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official match result and contemporaneous reporting of the completed match.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the national team declared the winner at full time in the September 19, 2026 fixture. If the match finishes level, resolve as Draw.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name, or Draw.
questions.accepted_format: The country's commonly used English name, or Draw.

questions.title: Which national team will win the first UEFA Nations League match between the Republic of Ireland and Israel in September 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the first Nations League match between these teams in September 2026.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the match finishes, using the final score. If neither team wins, resolve to a draw.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning national team's name, or the result designation if the match is drawn.
questions.accepted_format: The winning national team's name, or the result designation if the match is drawn.

questions.title: Which national team will lead UEFA Nations League Group A1 after the matches on September 28, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official group standings or contemporaneous reporting from reputable sports news organizations.
  • Resolution: Identify the national team ranked first in UEFA Nations League Group A1 after all matches played on September 28, 2026, have concluded. Apply UEFA's official tiebreaking rules if teams are level on points.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country name of the first-placed national team.
questions.accepted_format: The country name of the first-placed national team.
